items.name: animated-icons
items.title: Animated Icons core
items.description: Config, provider and icon factory shared by every animated icon. Adds --icon-primary/secondary/accent to your theme.

items.name: all
items.title: All animated icons
items.description: Every icon in the set (207), plus the core.

items.name: banknote
items.title: Banknote icon
items.description: 2 colors: note (primary), emblem and corner dots (accent).

items.name: battery
items.title: Battery icon
items.description: 3 colors: shell (primary), bolt and sparks (secondary), level (accent). Charges on its own.

items.name: bell
items.title: Bell icon
items.description: 2 colors: body (primary), clapper and sound waves (accent).

items.name: book-open
items.title: Book Open icon

items.name: bot
items.title: Bot icon

items.name: braces
items.title: Braces icon
items.description: 1 color. The dots only exist in motion.

items.name: brush
items.title: Brush icon
items.description: 3 colors: handle (primary), ferrule (secondary), bristles and the paint they lay down (accent).

items.name: bug
items.title: Bug icon
items.description: 2 colors: body and head (primary), legs and antennae (accent).

items.name: bus
items.title: Bus icon

items.name: door-open
